newsitem.title: DENMARK: Foreign buyers push Danish shares to new high.
newsitem.headline: Foreign buyers push Danish shares to new high.

text.p: Foreign interest and underlying positive sentiment pushed Danish share prices to a new high on Friday, the penultimate trading day of 1996.
Traders saw prices continuing to rise on Monday, the year's last session.
"There has been good interest throughout the day, mainly from foreign buyers. The index could well end 0.25 percent higher on Monday if this sentiment continues," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index rose 0.66 point to 134.03 on Friday, in overall bourse turnover of 618 million crowns. The KFX March future was untraded at 133.90.
